Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
I was just thinking about the 40 Weather Control deck and realized that
there might be a problem with it that hadn't occurred to me before.

Can Roreca Quaid play, say, 10 Weather Controls if she starts with two
blood on her? Or will she be sent to torpor on playing the third without
the opportunity to play any more?

Sad, if she can't play them all... means the zillion-Weather Control deck
just doesn't have the potential of the zillion-Drawing out the Beast
deck...

Josh

oh unhappy roreca...

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:


Roreca can play more WCs than she has blood. Card Text:

"Only usable at beginning of combat. Both combatants and their retainers
suffer 1 damage before range is determined each round, including the
first This damage cannot be prevented. (S) As Above, but the amount of
damage dealt increases by one each round."

Playing a weather control (at the beginning of combat) sets up an effect
that deals a damage at the start of the round. You don't immediately
remove one blood for each WC that is played instead you play as many as
you want and then move to the beggining of round where the damage then
occurrs.

By the way, my recent order of 30 weather control just arrived two days
ago. This will be my next deck!
--
